Convert TEM diameters to particle volumes

02
characterization

Construct nondimensional distributions

Use ψ1(η)=n(v)φ/N∞² and η=vN∞/φ, with N∞=∫n(v)dv and φ=∫v n(v)dv. ψ1 distributions are displayed for A–I in Figure 9. Raw n(v), counts and histogram processing are not supplied.

03
characterization

Compare radius means and moment ratios

r1=Σri/N∞; r3=(Σri³/N∞)^(1/3); rh=N∞/Σ(1/ri). Report µ1=r3/rh and µ3=r1/r3. The labels are the authors’ dimensionless radius ratios, not unqualified raw statistical moments.

04
characterization

Compare cumulative distributions with a coagulation model

ψ2(η)=Nv/N∞ and Nv=∫v∞n(v)dv. The printed ψ2 integral uses ψ1(η) with dv; preserve that notation as source text rather than implement an unverified dimensionless normalization. Figure 10 compares measurements with long-time Brownian coagulation and unit sticking probability.
